reviews.text: Great customer service and a large array of items!

Last week, I happened upon Queenie's in search of a new collar for my dog. I like to support small businesses when I can. The gentleman working there was helpful and I purchased two collars.

Yesterday, I went to return one of the collars--the tags and price sticker were still in tact and it wasn’t used at all. The same gentleman that assisted me when I purchased it was working. I had my receipt and I explained I wanted to return the collar.

He told me that I could not get my money back; I could only get store credit. That struck me as odd because he didn't mention that when I purchased the collars nor was that indicated anywhere on the receipt.

I told him, unfortunately, there was nothing I needed that I wanted to exchange. He then said, he can add the money to my account; I just wanted my money back. So, I walk aimlessly around the store trying to find something equivalent to the price of the collar, and after five minutes, I grabbed another collar and told the gentleman that I really don't need this stuff. I then asked him, "are you really unable to give me my money back?" He said he can give me my money back; it's just store policy to only issue store credit, but he will tell the store owner he "tried."

Time is currency and I didn't appreciate him wasting mine, and I certainly can't get  back my time.

In the future, be clear about your policies. If store policy is to only issue store credit for returns, then the store needs to make sure customers are aware of their policy.

I hope no one else experiences what I did.
Had a great experience here. Roswell was a huge help with what I needed for my dogs and new chameleons. Thank you!

Queenies Pets has been such a gift to both me and my girl, CoCo. Knowing she’s with people who truly love dogs and treat them like family gives me so much peace of mind. Mike and Dani are both wonderful with her — patient, caring, fun, and clearly animal people through and through. CoCo comes home happy, tired, and loved, and that makes this mama one very happy customer. I’m so grateful to have found Queenies Pets and the amazing people behind it. Highly recommend! 🐾❤️
Thank you very much!

Love supporting a small business plus everyone here is very nice and helpful. They carry a lot of alternative protein sources and treats if you have a dog with protein allergies (buffalo hide chews, ostrich bones, minnow treats, etc.) and if they don't have something in stock they will order for you

Queenie's is a true neighborhood gem! We greatly appreciate their attentive, personable staff and their extensive inventory which always meets the needs of our pets. We love being their down-the-street neighbors and are so grateful for all they do to care for our rabbit and turtle. Highly recommend!

This is an amazing pet store! I have a dog and so far I've found everything I need from these folks. They offer free local delivery, which is fantastic. They have a giant selection. To top it all off, they are just lovely humans. Thank you for being in Philly!
Nice range of products, fairly priced for a variety of animals. They even carried Smalls cat food which is challenging to find. Pleasant staff.
Wonderful staff and selection! Spent time to help me understand and choose products for my cat's specific needs, but with no hard-sell tactics. Def recommend
Thank you Krista! We are so thrilled that your new kitty got their gift basket after a long and arduous journey! :)

We have been using Queenie's since they started 20 years ago. With other sitters I'd wonder; did they get in ok, what if they get sick. With Queenie's, I know they have a staff of several sitters. So, if someone can't make it there is someone to fill in. This is really a case of you get what you pay for. And this is top notch service. They have contingency plans already laid out for snow, ice and extreme heat. Great service (even though I seldom get to meet any of the sitters.) Adina has thought this through as a true business, with customer service a top priority.
Thank you!
Staff is so nice and knowledgeable - gave me free samples and extra treats for my new pup!

A pet care service that is always reliable, friendly, and works as a partner with you to care for your pet?  Yes—look no further!  We’ve used QP for nearly ten years since moving to NW Philadelphia for all of our dog walking and full time overnight care for our dog while we are out of town.  Our dog loves all of his caregivers and can’t wait to spend time with them. Whether we’re away for the day or a week of travel out of the country, we never worry about our dog while he’s being taken care of by the Queenie’s team!  Also—they have a terrific store with quality products and insightful recommendations from the team…and prices at or below the big box chain stores. We (and our dog) love this business and their team so much!
Always great with my cat!  Staff is very attentive and my cat loves them. Highly recommend their services!
Queenie's is fantastic. They provide excellent and loving care for our dog and 2 cats. Completely reliable.

Queenies is a one of a kind stop for your pets! The entire staff is helpful, knowledgeable, and truly cares about the well being of the person & pets they are serving. Everytime I bring my pup in, he is greeted by name and absolutely spoiled!! They make ordering easy, and make you feel like you're part of their family from the moment you walk in. They go above and beyond with every customers need, & once you start shopping here you will never want to shop anywhere else! Thank you Adina & queenies crew for being such a remarkable pet store

Great pet store with a friendly staff. I haven't used their pet care services, but many of my clients rave about them. People show me framed pictures of their pets that Queenies gave them. Seems like they really care about your pets and your family.
Love Queenie's!! We worked with Adina's team for years and had the happiest pup that could be. We could always count on them to provide super high quality, reliable, easy-to-manage care.
It’s great having a local pet store with really knowledgeable staff and usually a friendly cat or dog in the shop :) I love that they always have samples of dog food to take and try!
Best pet shop in the area. The owner is amazing and the store is great! Thanks you

Lovely store! Staff is super wonderful and kind - place is organized and positive. Roswell helped me find what I needed promptly, and other times I’ve come in, Eselina and Patti were also wonderful! Will be coming in again if only for the great staff :) and for my cats too haha.
Wonderful crew at Queenies. We use their pet care services and shop at the store for our own pet. Friendly and helpful staff.
Great place to shop for all your pet needs and advice or suggestions. Adina is wonderful, staff is friendly and accommodating. Love the healthy variety of food and treats. 😊 …
I recieved very helpful & compassionate service when finding dietary options for my cat thats currently sick. Thanks so much

Queenie's has been taking care of our cats for almost 9 years and they are never anything less than wonderful. Our cats are high-maintenance, get into everything, eat multiple special diets and are all-around pains, and our sitters get every detail right and then some. I am so thankful to be able to travel without worrying, knowing that our pets are in trusted, professional hands.

We receive monthly deliveries of food and other items for our two senior dogs from Queenie’s. Products & service are of the highest quality. Everyone we’ve interacted with is kind and helpful and Adina goes above and beyond wrt taking the time to share her vast knowledge and provide personalized advice. She’s also an exceptionally generous and caring person. We are excited to use Queenie’s pet sitting service too—Patti is likewise incredible to work with, another gem of a human. Really glad to have this business in our neighborhood
